name: SilphScope-Network
description: Send your current character (map position + party, plus a choice of 6 ghost sprites) to a shared file that lives outside any save (or, with experimental ONLINE MODE, to a small server too, optionally password-gated to a private pool). Other saves find your sent character standing where you left them: it spots you and forces a battle, with optional dialogue you wrote. Once beaten, interact with it to hear its after-battle line again (or fight again if repeatable battles are on). Test build.
